privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
title: An expired or rejected approval ends the step
goal: One card per approval-needing step: a declined or expired tool is never proposed again in the sortie
acceptance: A committed test fails first, unchanged by the fix: after an expired (and, separately, a rejected) approval, the same action proposed again produced a second card

After the fix the sortie closes with a reply naming the tool and why; no second approval exists; owner-initiated cards are not deferred (no global quiet hours; proactive cards already bundle overnight)

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-16: one regression across ledger and sorties, a stop after expiry/reject, quiet-hours check in deliverApproval. Not a measurement. No actual: not timed by the session that closed it.
